name: 蕭勝輝
objective: 本課程將介紹如何利用紅外線光譜、質譜、核磁共振光譜及紫外線光譜等所提供的光譜資料來鑑定有機化合物的結構。除了光譜的解釋之外，也會教授基本的分析原理。
schedule:
1. Molecular Formulas and What can be Learned from them
2. Infrared Spectroscopy
3. Mass Spectrometry
4. Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy Part 1: Basic Concepts
5. Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy Part 2: Carbon-13 Spectra, Including Heteronuclear Coupling with Other Nuclei
6. Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy Part 3: Spin-Spin Coupling
7. Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy Part 4: Other Topics in One-Dimensional NMR
8. Ultraviolet Spectroscopy
9. Combined Structure Problems
10. Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy Part 5: Advanced NMR Techniques
scorePolicy:
課程參與度 學習態度 10%
作業 20%
期中測驗 35%
期末測驗 35%
materials:
教科書: Lampman/Pavia/Kriz/Vyvyan, "Introduction to Spectroscopy", 5th edition, CENGAGE Learning, 2015
參考書: R. M. Silverstein, F. X. Webster, "Spectrometric Identification of Organic Compounds", 6th edition, Wiley, 1997
